verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair axis for a self-hosted AI assistant. The evidence shows only that memory is written as plain Markdown files in the workspace and that session history is SQLite-backed per agent. It documents no retention settings, history-deletion commands, or purge controls. Deleting those files by hand is a user-side workaround, and revocable chat links and secret scrubbing are adjacent features, so none of these earn credit.
